children: On October 29, 2026, Annovis Bio received notice from the NYSE that it failed to meet Section 802.01B because its 30-trading-day average market capitalization was below $50 million while stockholders’ equity was also below $50 million. It plans to submit a compliance plan within 45 days and, if accepted, will have nine months from the notice to regain compliance; its shares will continue trading on the NYSE during the cure period, with a .BC designation.
